correction: 14-after-resume.json recorded FAIL with sleptAcrossDueTime=false. This machine uses Modern Standby: it logged Kernel-Power 107 'resumed' two seconds after 42 'entering sleep', then a 0.3 s 506/507 blip at the real wake, and the script paired the wake with that blip (sleep 16:27:45Z) instead of the ten-minute sleep. Fixed in the harness: 14-verify takes the interval from Windows' Power-Troubleshooter summary and only falls back to pairing raw events without one; re-evaluated against this run's System log it gives slept 16:17:08Z to 16:27:45Z, across the due time, delivery after resume. The 14-toast.png frame is empty: 14v started a minute after the delivery, by which time the toast had left the screen; the notification-centre capture carries the delivery.
